name: When should I repair my door frame versus replacing the entire door?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair my door frame versus replacing the entire door?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider repairing a door frame if the damage is localized to a small section, such as a split jamb, minor rot, or cosmetic dings. If the structural integrity of the frame is compromised due to extensive rot, severe splitting, or widespread pest damage, a full replacement is often more cost-effective and safer. Replacement is also advisable if the frame is outdated and you're upgrading to a different door style or material for better security or energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor damage like splits or small areas of rot. Replace the frame if damage is extensive, structural integrity is compromised, or you're upgrading.
